neighbours.label: the piece after 'Sol' in Solanum / Solano / Solana
fire: The potato, Solanum tuberosum, was brought to Europe in the sixteenth century.
We drove through Solano County on the way to Sacramento.
The surf at Solana Beach was perfect that morning.
Eggplant and peppers belong to the Solanaceae, the nightshade family.
The mission church was named after St. Francis Solano.
Several Solanum species are toxic to livestock.
A new restaurant opened near the station in Solana Beach.
The Solano County fair takes place every summer.
quiet: The potato was brought to Europe from the Andes in the sixteenth century.
We drove through Sonoma County on the way to Sacramento.
The surf at Pacific Beach was perfect that morning.
Eggplant and peppers belong to the nightshade family.
The mission church was named after St. Francis of Assisi.
Several nightshade species are toxic to livestock.
A new restaurant opened near the station in Del Mar.
The Sonoma County fair takes place every summer.
